{"code": "
seq = "".join(l.strip() for l in open("region.fasta") if not l.startswith(">")).upper()
n=len(seq)
comp={'A':'T','T':'A','G':'C','C':'G','N':'N'}
R = ''.join(comp[c] for c in reversed(seq))   # reverse complement

# ungapped local alignment (Kadane) on every diagonal, comparing seq vs R
MATCH=2; MISM=-3
results=[]
for d in range(-(n-1), n):
    # compare seq[i] with R[i-d]  => diagonal offset d = i - j
    i0 = max(0,d); j0 = max(0,-d)
    score=0; start=0; L=len(R)-j0 if d>=0 else len(seq)-i0
    L=min(n-i0, n-j0)
    cur_start=0
    for k in range(L):
        i=i0+k; j=j0+k
        s = MATCH if seq[i]==R[j] else MISM
        if score<=0:
            score=s; cur_start=k
        else:
            score+=s
        if score>0:
            results.append((score, i0+cur_start, k-cur_start+1, d))
# keep top non-redundant
results.sort(reverse=True)
kept=[]
for sc,st,ln,d in results:
    if any(abs(st-a)<50 for a,b,c,_ in kept): continue
    kept.append((sc,st,ln,d))
    if len(kept)>=8: break
print("Top ungapped self-RC alignments (score, start0, len, diag):")
for sc,st,ln,d in kept:
    # first arm coords: seq[st:st+ln] ; second arm coords in original seq:
    i0=max(0,d); j0=max(0,-d)
    jj = j0 + (st - i0)              # start index in R
    arm2 = (n-1-(jj+ln-1), n-1-jj)   # inclusive 0-based coords in original seq
    a1=seq[st:st+ln]; a2=seq[arm2[0]:arm2[1]+1]
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y)/ln
    print(f"score={sc} len={ln} id={ident:.2f} arm1={st+1}-{st+ln} arm2={arm2[0]+1}-{arm2[1]+1}")
    print("   ",a1)
    print("   ",a2)
"}
